data.narrative:
Tobe Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Colby DeWeese and Caleb Lareau that has raised $4.6M to date. The valuation landscape for this sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, though no private peers share Tobe's exact stage and valuation tier.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression. Using total capital raised ($4.6M, proxied as $5M) as a base, application of a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $12M. This method captures the expected return profile for investors moving from Seed into Series A rounds within the climate and energy sector. A peer-median approach could not be applied; while nine Climate & Energy companies exist in the comp universe, zero same-stage peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-tier peers met the threshold for statistical reliability. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable distortion.

The triangulated analysis, constrained by single-method input, supports a valuation range of $10M (low) to $13M (high), with a median of $12M. This range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression output but carries material uncertainty. Key dependencies include the stability of Seed-to-Series A multipliers in frontier energy markets and the assumption that $4.6M raised is representative of the company's developmental stage and capital efficiency. Additional comparable data at identical or tightly adjacent stages would strengthen conviction in this range.
